nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) balances in BasicToken; core ledger of token balances.
uint256 totalSupply_ in BasicToken; total token supply in existence.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowed; ERC20 allowance ledger.
address public owner in Ownable; privileged account for onlyOwner functions.
bool public paused in Pausable; emergency stop flag gating token transfers.
uint256 internal constant K_INITIAL_SUPPLY = 2100000000 * 10**18; minted at construction.
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool); moves tokens from msg.sender.
balanceOf(address _owner) public view returns (uint256); reads balances mapping.
totalSupply() public view returns (uint256); returns totalSupply_.
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) public returns (bool); allowance-spending transfer.
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) public returns (bool); writes allowance.
allowance(address _owner, address _spender) public view returns (uint256); reads allowed mapping.
increaseApproval(address _spender, uint256 _addedValue) public returns (bool); adds to allowance.
decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint256 _subtractedValue) public returns (bool); subtracts from allowance.
constructor() public; sets owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner; owner-gated ownership transfer.
_transferOwnership(address _newOwner) internal; performs ownership state change.
pause() onlyOwner whenNotPaused public; sets paused = true.
unpause() onlyOwner whenPaused public; sets paused = false.
transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) public whenNotPaused; delegates to super.transfer.
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) public whenNotPaused; delegates to super.transferFrom.
approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) public whenNotPaused; delegates to super.approve.
increaseApproval(address _spender, uint _addedValue) public whenNotPaused; delegates to super.
decreaseApproval(address _spender, uint _subtractedValue) public whenNotPaused; delegates to super.
constructor() public; mints K_INITIAL_SUPPLY to msg.sender and sets totalSupply_.
SafeMath.sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure; asserts b <= a then subtracts.
SafeMath.add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure; adds with overflow assert.
SafeMath.mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure; multiplies with overflow assert.
msg.sender; attacker-controllable caller identity used for balance, allowance and ownership logic.
balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) in transfer; arithmetic decrement of sender balance.
balances[_to].add(_value) in transfer/transferFrom; arithmetic increment of recipient balance.
allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) in transferFrom; arithmetic decrement of allowance.
allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue) in increaseApproval; arithmetic allowance growth.
oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue) in decreaseApproval; arithmetic allowance reduction.
K_INITIAL_SUPPLY computation 2100000000 * 10 ** uint256(decimals); fixed-point arithmetic for initial mint.
owner = _newOwner in _transferOwnership; privileged ownership state change (access control).
onlyOwner modifier check require(msg.sender == owner); authorization gate (access control).

address _newOwner of transferOwnership; new privileged owner.
uint256 oldValue local in decreaseApproval; cached current allowance.
